title: Oscar and the Detention
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Sebastian Eriksen, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
